name: Waltz by JB Glass
description: JB Glass is an innovation- and technology-driven brand that has transformed how glass is viewed, used and imagined in architecture, interior spaces and lifestyle products. The company focuses on technology, innovation and developing advanced glass products and solutions for architects, interior designers and product designers across India.

name: Slashform
description: Slashform is a premium interior and furniture brand specializing in custom kitchens, wardrobes and bespoke living spaces, combining craftsmanship, high-precision manufacturing and modern engineering.

name: NewTechWood
description: NewTechWood is a composite decking manufacturer offering composite decking, siding, cladding, railings, fencing and other outdoor-living products. Its products feature UltraShield technology, designed to protect against rotting, fading, staining and scratching.

name: Formica
description: Formica is an iconic surface-material brand closely associated with the invention of the original High Pressure Laminate (HPL). Today, Formica Group provides designed surfacing solutions for residential and commercial applications worldwide.

name: Loco
description:
LOCO Design is a multidisciplinary design brand inspired by a heritage of fine craftsmanship and innovation. Its work spans design, craft and enterprise, creating contemporary works and solutions.
Brand Focus: The brand combines contemporary design with traditional craftsmanship, creating distinctive products and spaces across interior, architectural and lifestyle applications.

name: Falper
description: Falper is an Italian luxury design brand creating high-end bathroom and kitchen furnishings. Its collections combine iconic design, refined materials, advanced technology and skilled craftsmanship.

name: Fima Carlo Frattini
description: FIMA Carlo Frattini is an Italian luxury fittings brand known for combining Italian design, technical precision, craftsmanship and innovation in premium bathroom and kitchen solutions.

name: Inkiostro Bianco
description: Inkiostro Bianco is an Italian creative brand specializing in artistic wallpaper, wooden wallcoverings and designer rugs, transforming interiors through creative and innovative surface solutions.

name: Mafi
description: mafi specialises in high-quality, 100% ecological natural wood floors and coordinated interior solutions, combining traditional craftsmanship with technical innovation.

name: Mirage
description: Mirage is an Italian ceramics brand specialising in porcelain stoneware flooring and wall coverings for residential, commercial and public spaces. The brand combines design, research, technological innovation and high technical performance.

name: Freedom Screens
description: Freedom Screens is a specialist in retrofit retractable screening solutions, offering balcony, privacy, insect, sun and rain-protection screens. The brand combines style, quality and intelligent innovation in its screening systems.

name: Peelply
description: Engineered premium plywood and veneers.

name: Inclass
description: Contemporary Spanish designer lifestyle furniture.

name: WOW
description: WOW Design is a Spanish tile design studio specializing in unique, high-value ceramic tiles for architecture and interior design. It focuses particularly on small-format tiles, distinctive shapes, colours, textures and finishes.

name: IWW
description: IW is a Spanish architectural water systems brand focused on design, engineering and material integrity. It develops integrated water systems that treat water as an architectural element within bathrooms and wellness spaces.

name: Living Ceramica
description: Livingceramics creates unique ceramic solutions for interior design and architecture, with innovation and design as fundamental pillars of its work. Its portfolio includes porcelain, wall and floor tiles, large-format surfaces, bathroom furniture and washbasins.

name: Florim
description: Florim is an Italian company specialising in porcelain surfaces for architecture and interior design, offering solutions for floors, walls, countertops and furnishings. The brand combines design, technological innovation, quality and sustainability.

name: Gelli
description: Artisanal decorative glass and mirrors.

name: Jacuzzi
description: Jacuzzi is a pioneering wellness and hydrotherapy brand, best known for its hot tubs, whirlpool baths and innovative water-therapy products. The brand continues to combine hydrotherapy, design, engineering and wellness technology.

name: Alex Turco
description: Alex Turco is an Italian artist and Art Designer known for creating handmade artistic surfaces, panels, paintings and collectible design pieces. His work combines art, interior design, photography, digital imagery and handcrafted materials such as epoxy resin.
